name: NEXA Student Tutor
description: The Student Tutor Agent's tutoring loop (NEXA-M4-002), for students only. Grounded explanations from the approved curriculum, adaptive re-explanation, practice questions, hints, feedback on the student's answers with misconception checks, and follow-ups on the same topic, using the student's session. Never marks or grades; teacher-only requests are refused; when the curriculum cannot be reached it says so instead of guessing.

steps.title: What the student is asking for

when.matches: \b(answer keys?|marking (guide|scheme|key)|memo for|teacher'?s? (guide|notes|copy|edition)|exam (paper|answers)|test answers|(do|finish|complete|write) my (homework|assignment|test|exam|project|essay|report)|lesson plan|(mark|grade|score) (my|this)|what (mark|grade|score) (would|will|do|did) i get|give me (a|my) (mark|grade|score))\b

rules.reason: teacher-only material, assessed work or a mark: not for the tutor (role boundary)

when.matches: \b(hint|clue|i'?m stuck|i am stuck|help me (start|with this)|where do i start)\b

rules.reason: a hint for the current practice question

when.matches: ^\s*(my answer|answer:|answer is|i got|i get|i think (it|the answer) (is|'s)|is it|it'?s|it is|=|[-+]?\d)

rules.reason: the student answers the practice question
an arithmetic expression: computed by the calculator

steps.title: The question, standalone (follow-ups resolved)
Grounded answer from the approved curriculum
steps.question: {{steps.question.output}}

steps.title: Grounded, and what kind of help
Teach it, from the curriculum answer
The curriculum answer as it is (the teaching step failed)
One practice question on the topic
The next hint, not the answer
The practice question's calculation, as an expression
steps.prompt:
Write the single arithmetic expression that computes the answer to this question. Use only numbers, + - * / ^ ( ) and %. Reply with the expression only. If the question needs no calculation, reply NONE.

Question: {{session.practice}}

steps.title: Feedback on the student's answer (no mark)
Write the calculation as an expression
steps.prompt:
Write the single arithmetic expression that computes the answer to the question below. Use only numbers, + - * / ^ ( ) and %. Reply with the expression only: no words, no units, no equals sign.

Question: {{input.message}}

steps.title: Explain the working
steps.prompt:
A Grade {{input.grade}} student asked: {{input.message}}

The calculator computed {{steps.compute.result.text}}. Explain the working step by step and state the final answer using exactly this result. Say that this is a worked answer, not a passage from the curriculum.

steps.title: Not in the curriculum: say so, then a careful general answer
steps.prompt:
A Grade {{input.grade}} student asked: {{steps.question.output}}

The approved curriculum does not cover this. Start by saying so plainly. Then, only if it is a school-learning question you are sure about, give a short general explanation labelled as general knowledge, not from the curriculum; if you are not sure, say you are not sure and suggest asking their teacher. Do not cite any source.

steps.title: The curriculum cannot be reached: no guessing
steps.output: I can't check the curriculum right now, so I won't guess an answer. Please try again in a few minutes, or ask your teacher.

steps.title: Not for the tutor (role boundary)
steps.output: I can't give marks, answer keys, teacher material, or do work that will be assessed. Your teacher decides marks. I can explain the topic, give you a practice question, or look at your working and help you find the next step.
